plan: Tori & Tia are two Dancer Oricorio whose Revelation Dance copies can produce up to four attacks a turn. The dossier crack names Ground/Normal immunity to the relevant Revelation Dance type, removing a bird, and special mitigation. Excadrill is immune to Pom-Pom's Electric Revelation Dance and threatens both birds with Rock Slide; Weavile's Triple Axel is 2x into both birds and Ice Shard is priority that beats a Tailwind turn. Gyarados-Mega Ice Fang and Togekiss Follow Me cover the Ribombee/Frosmoth back half; Incineroar Fake Out denies the first Tailwind or dance.
